easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Glorious Protector, and Changeling Titan must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Titan for its mana cost.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
